cardSpecification.objective:
Execute Phase 4 pre-flight readiness audit for the SLAWS and SLAAT cross-plane permutation test harness.
Verify that all prerequisite baseline artifacts from SLAAT Phase 1 through Phase 3 and SLAWS Phase 5 are intact on disk.
Assert that probe scripts, BATS test suites, Go toolchains, and offline test environments are available and functional.
Calibrate the cross-plane permutation execution environment to ensure zero false positives caused by toolchain or cache drift.
Establish a verified pre-flight audit record in ci-evidence/ certifying platform readiness for one-shot permutation runs.
cardSpecification.approach:
Audit the existence and executability of all five SLAAT probe scripts under scripts/probe-*.sh.
Audit SLAWS telemetry ingestion packages under d2-signalloom/apps/signal-ingest/ and CEL policy modules under d2-signalloom/pkg/obscel.
Confirm that Go build caches, BATS harness paths, and Python uv virtual environments are configured properly for offline test execution.
Run a dry-run invocation of scripts/slaws-slaat-permutation-matrix.sh to verify parameter handling and evidence ledger generation.
Verify that no active process leaks or locked sockets interfere with port-forwarding or local probe listeners.
Inspect the local Kind cluster or offline mock fixtures to ensure deterministic test execution across all 16 permutation vectors.
Record pre-flight findings, toolchain versions, and readiness hashes in the errata ledger to unblock implementation card SLAAT-P4-1.
deliverables: Phase 4 pre-flight audit manifest ci-evidence/slaat-p4-pre-readiness-audit.json certifying test environment readiness
Verification of all five SLAAT probe scripts across ingress, API, SPIFFE, OpenBao, and Sentinel attack surfaces
Verification of SLAWS telemetry ingest collectors, FrostDB storage interfaces, and obscel policy evaluation modules
Dry-run baseline execution of scripts/slaws-slaat-permutation-matrix.sh demonstrating clean parameter parsing and JSON reporting
Pre-flight errata ledger entry in the SLAAT proposal document recording audit checksums and readiness confirmations
Clean hand-off to implementation card SLAAT-P4-1 with verified dependency chains and zero unresolved prerequisites
testSurface: bash ./scripts/slaws-slaat-permutation-matrix.sh --dry-run: asserts matrix harness executes and parses flags cleanly with rc 0
bats test/slaws-slaat-cross-plane-probes.bats: runs unit and regression tests verifying permutation harness behavior
test -x scripts/probe-api-idor-boundaries.sh -a -x scripts/probe-network-isolation.sh: verifies probe scripts are executable
test -x scripts/probe-openbao-acls.sh -a -x scripts/probe-sentinel-evasion.sh -a -x scripts/probe-spiffe-privilege-escalation.sh: asserts probe executability
scripts/kanban-check.sh link-check --shortcode SLAAT: confirms zero broken dependencies or unlinked cards in Phase 4
evidence: Pre-flight audit manifest in ci-evidence/slaat-p4-pre-readiness-audit.json with status READY and verified component checks
Zero errors and clean status reported by scripts/slaws-slaat-permutation-matrix.sh under dry-run verification
Clean exit status 0 from test/slaws-slaat-cross-plane-probes.bats execution across all test cases
Confirmed permissions and execute bits on all five scripts/probe-*.sh adversarial probe tools
Updated errata block in docs/Proposal - SLAAT Whole-System Autonomous Adversarial Testing (2026-Q4).md
failureModes: Missing or unexecutable probe scripts in scripts/ directory causing permutation matrix failure during execution
Corrupted Go toolchain cache or permission denied on /tmp/gocache preventing obscel or sentinel test compilation
Unreachable local Kubernetes cluster context or missing mock fixtures leading to false-negative probe rejections
Existing zombie port-forwards or dangling socket listeners blocking local port allocations during live probe execution
Divergent git working tree state or uncommitted merge conflicts violating clean pre-flight verification invariants
outOfScope: Modifying production Kubernetes cluster manifests or reconfiguring Envoy Gateway routes
Executing the full 16-vector live permutation matrix battery (allocated to SLAAT-P4-1)
Refactoring core Go source code in signal-ingest, policy-engine, or stun-sentinel
Altering OpenBao token lifetimes or re-issuing SPIRE trust domain intermediate certificates
Certifying release deliverables or compiling final governance manifests (allocated to SLAAT-P4-GOV)
keyFacts: Phase 4 unifies SLAWS AWS telemetry ingestion with SLAAT autonomous adversarial exploit probing
Five defensive planes must be validated: Ingress, Backend API IDOR, SPIFFE Identity, OpenBao Secrets, and Sentinel/Landlock
Pre-flight verification must complete cleanly before implementation card SLAAT-P4-1 can be claimed or started
All card specifications must strictly satisfy size band floors and maintain acyclic dependency graph integrity
consumesFromEarlierPhases: SLAAT Phase 3 final governor certification report and consolidated attack replay evidence
SLAWS Phase 5 acceptance harness, collectors/awslogs implementation, and obscel CEL rule bundles
loopOn: Stale or uncleaned temporary cache files in /tmp/ until gocache and gomodcache directories are verified clean
Harness parameter parsing checks until slaws-slaat-permutation-matrix.sh reports 100% dry-run validation
stopAndReport: Any missing probe script or unresolvable test dependency that cannot be executed in the test environment
Any corrupted Parquet partition metadata or broken CEL bundle syntax discovered during pre-flight checks
Any broken DAG link or unresolvable dependency detected by kanban-check.sh link-check
sharedFileRisks: ci-evidence/ directory contains baseline reports from prior phases; ensure pre-flight audit uses unique file paths
cardSpecification.mergeBoundary: SLAAT-P4-PRE evidence is merged by SLAAT-P4-GOV into refs/heads/integration/slaat-whole-system-adversarial; must not force-push or rebase
priorErrata: SLAAT-P3-GOV certified final mission hand-off with 24/24 attack findings verified and 338 tests passing
